_comment: Example finding emitted by canister-audit for the token_vault fixture, in the shape scripts/vuln-poc-gate.sh `command` mode validates. On a REAL target the skill fills target_repo/target_commit with the cloned repo and its audited HEAD (the gate rejects a commit that does not match the checkout); the value below is an illustrative placeholder.
attacker_controls: Any caller, including the unauthenticated anonymous principal, invoking the claim_bonus(amount) update method with an arbitrary amount.
attacker_achieves: Credits its own balance from nothing with no deposit and no owner guard, breaking sum(balances) <= total_deposited, then withdraws funds other users deposited (theft).
